instruction: Please implement a website that captures user interactions on the webpage. The website should have the functionality to capture user behaviors such as clicking, scrolling, and hovering. Users can perform various operations on the website, and the website should be able to record and analyze these behaviors in real-time. The website should have the functionality to display user behavior records, including click counts, scroll distance, and hover time. Select light green for layout background and dark olive green for component details.

Please implement a Sudoku mini-program that provides Sudoku practice and competition functions. The mini-program should have features such as daily Sudoku, Sudoku practice, Sudoku PK, and Sudoku competition publishing. Users should be able to log in to the mini-program, browse and select different types of Sudoku puzzles, practice and compete in Sudoku, and view their scores and rankings. The mini-program should also be able to generate Sudoku puzzles and solutions with different rules. Implement mint frost for the page background and seagreen for the elements.

Please implement a WeChat mini-program backend management system for managing users, products, points, and marketing plans. The system should have user management functions, including adding, deleting, and modifying user information; product management functions, including adding, deleting, and modifying product information; point management functions, including issuing and verifying points; and marketing plan management functions, including creating, modifying, and deleting marketing plans. Administrators should be able to log in to the system, browse, and manage user, product, point, and marketing plan information. Use thistle as the default background and rebecca purple for component styling.

Please implement a high-performance and lightweight website that has fast loading and response capabilities. Users should be able to quickly access the website, browse content, and perform operations. The website should have a user-friendly interface that is easy to navigate and use. The website should also have a search function that allows users to quickly find the content they need. Use opal for the outer layout and indigo for UI blocks.

Please implement a comment system that allows users to post comments and replies. The system should have comment modules, comment reply modules, like modules, backend management modules, user blocking modules, and comment flow control modules. Users can log in to the system, post comments, reply to others' comments, like comments, and view their own comment history. Backend administrators can manage comment content, delete violating comments, block violating users, and set comment flow control rules. Apply theme using light sky blue as background and dodger blue for elements.

Please implement a B2B e-commerce website for business-to-business transactions and information exchange. The website should have functionalities for publishing and browsing supply and demand information, managing company profiles, showcasing products, recruiting talent, and publishing news, as well as conducting transactions. Users should be able to log in, publish and browse supply and demand information, manage company profiles, showcase products, publish job openings and news, and conduct transactions. Choose gainsboro for the background; set all component colors to dark slate blue.

Please implement a database management system to optimize and manage bank business data. The system should have data security and stability, and be able to respond quickly to data requests. Users should be able to log in, browse and manage the database, optimize the database architecture, and ensure the security and stability of the data. Choose frost white for global background and charcoal for all components.

Please implement an application to centralize LinkedIn messages from multiple accounts. The application should allow users to connect multiple LinkedIn accounts and switch between them to respond to messages received in the messaging system. The application should have account management functionality, enabling users to add, remove, and switch between accounts. Users should be able to view messages from all accounts and perform actions such as replying, marking as read, or deleting messages for each account. Set page background to mint; color all components with dark sea green.

Please implement an end-to-end encrypted database website for secure data storage and querying. The website should have functionalities for data storage, remote querying, data encryption, and decryption. Users should be able to register and log in to the website, upload and store data, execute remote queries without needing to download the data, and view query results while keeping the data encrypted during transmission and storage. Implement styling with light yellow for the background and dark khaki for components.

Please implement a healthcare talent marketplace website to connect healthcare professionals with employers. The website should have functionalities for registration, login, search, and job application. Users can register as healthcare professionals or employers, log in to the website, search for and apply for jobs, and manage their personal information and resumes. Employers can post job openings, manage job applications, and candidate information. Apply apricot to the canvas background and chocolate to all visible components.

Please implement a virtual character interaction website for library administrators to provide consulting services. The website should have functionalities such as a launch page, virtual character list, news list, virtual character introduction, character conversation, and login page. Users should be able to browse the virtual character list, view character introductions, engage in conversations, and obtain library-related information. The website should also have a language conversation function, allowing users to interact with virtual characters through voice or text. Select wheat for layout background and chocolate for component details.

Please implement an RSS feed aggregation and automation website to extract data from government data RSS feeds. The website should have the following functionalities: periodically visit specified URLs, download RSS files, monitor RSS updates, and when there are new updates, download HTML links as HTM and PDF files, and save these files to a specified storage location. Users should be able to view downloaded files and manage storage locations. Use lemon mist for container backgrounds and dark orange for component visuals.

Please implement a multilingual website that includes support for the Hindi language. The website should have a language switching function that allows users to switch between different languages, including Hindi. The website should be able to correctly display Hindi characters and content. Users should be able to register and log in to the website and browse its content, including articles, news, and product information. Implement desert sand for the page background and sienna for the elements.

Please implement a tea recording mini-program to record users' tea drinking diaries. The mini-program should have functionalities for recording tea drinking diaries, selecting tea, water, and utensils. Users should be able to record detailed information about each tea drinking experience, including tea type, water temperature, and utensils, and share their tea diaries on social media. After sharing, they can receive rewards, such as badges. Choose faint gold for the background; set all component colors to saddle brown.

Please implement an online photo gallery website for displaying and managing images. The website should have functionalities for adding, deleting, and editing images, as well as adding descriptions, setting password protection, and access permissions. Users should be able to browse images, view image descriptions, and access protected images based on their permissions. Assign moccasin as the background color and apply sandy brown to all elements.

Please implement a form parsing tool website for bulk processing of spreadsheet files. The website should have functionalities for uploading spreadsheet files, parsing spreadsheet data, converting data formats, and downloading conversion results. Users should be able to upload multiple spreadsheet files, select the data format for parsing and conversion, process spreadsheet files in bulk, and download the processed results. Use wheat for container backgrounds and chocolate for component visuals.

Please implement a concurrent script running website that automatically runs developed scripts concurrently. The website should have functionalities for script uploading, concurrent running, and process control. Users should be able to upload scripts and set the number of concurrent processes, and the website should automatically run the scripts concurrently, providing the ability to view running status and results. Assign silver as the background color and apply dark slate blue to all elements.

Please implement a rapid development web application for building powerful, fast, and reliable web pages. The application should have the functionality to handle various database-driven HTML data page generation, including support for multiple database connections, data queries, and data display. Users should be able to quickly build and deploy their own web applications using this application, including e-commerce websites, blogs, and more. Apply theme using white smoke as background and rosy brown for elements.

Please implement a geographically related sharing platform for sharing and searching events in different locations. The platform should have functionalities for sharing events, searching for different types of events, and searching for events near a location on a map. Users should be able to log in, share their own events, search for events of interest, view the location of events, and learn more about the events. Use light salmon for container backgrounds and coral for component visuals.

Please implement a television video playback website for playing TV videos and managing charging functions. The website should have functionalities for video playback, TV set-top box charging, and mobile phone recharge. Users should be able to log in, browse and play TV videos, manage their own charging information, and perform mobile phone recharge operations. Configure your theme with thistle as background and rebecca purple as component color.

Please implement an artificial intelligence-based travel application that provides personalized travel recommendations. The application should have navigation features, allowing users to browse different destinations, activities, and services. Users should be able to input their personal preferences and interests, and the application will provide personalized recommendations based on this information. The application should also include user account management, search functionality, and trip planning tools. Set all pages to have a linen background and saddle brown components.
